188K likes, 1,393 comments - service95bookclub on October 21, 2026: "The value of a book comes from seeing the world differently because of it.

To celebrate the start of London Literature Festival, curated by @dualipa and @service95bookclub, tonight we took over @piccadillylights to share a special message from Dua, brought to life by the wonderful illustrator and animator @ramaduwaji. 

It serves as a reminder that books do far more than tell stories. They help us witness the world through different eyes, walk in unfamiliar shoes and understand perspectives beyond our own. 

Join us at the @southbankcentre from today until Sunday 1 November to discover the literary icons and exciting new voices inspiring us all to Read The World Differently.

Get your tickets at the link in bio.

Words by: Dua Lipa @dualipa
Animation by: Rama Duwaji @ramaduwaji
Sound Design by: Leila Wilkinson @leilawilkinson_".

posts.meta_description:
116K likes, 653 comments - service95bookclub on October 12, 2026: "Still time to get your tickets! London Literature Festival 2026 is almost here, with the @SouthbankCentre set to welcome literary icons, boundary-pushing writers and some of the most exciting new voices to the city. Curated by @DuaLipa and @Service95BookClub, the festival runs from Tuesday 20 October to Sunday 1 November, with conversations, workshops, stories and big ideas across the programme.

Swipe for a taste of what’s in store.

📚 Translated Fiction Showcase – the fiction you need to know about, featuring @SamantaSchweblin (Argentina), @NelioBiedermann (Switzerland), @GaelFaye (Rwanda) and @SihIrperempuan (Indonesia). Hosted by @Hopendabapr.
📚 Fierce Sounds – an evening exploring rhythm, form and sound in writing with @KaeTempest, @OmarBinMusa, @jacquelinecrooks1, @SufiyaanSalam and @Yomi_Sode. 
📚 Service95 x English PEN: Censorship Live! – hosted by journalist and broadcaster @olbullough confronting rising threats to expression. 
📚Creative Encounters - make, create and explore with artist @zoethezinester, inspired by @LivrariaLello’s Manifesto Library and its books challenging power and censorship. 

Link in bio for tickets.".
